Al-Adsani v. United Kingdom (ECtHR Grand Chamber, 2001) ended 9–8 in favour of the UK: the Court found no violation of Article 6 because granting Kuwait state immunity pursued a legitimate aim and was proportionate. The Court treated immunity as a limit on access to a court that is compatible with the right to a fair trial, so it did not conflict with it. Of the options, C matches that reasoning best, though B is a plausible alternative reading of the result.

CONFIDENCE: 60
